Topic: Cramer's Rule: A Geometric Perspective

Target audience: University students (Linear Algebra/Calculus)

Section: section_1 — Prerequisite Review: Determinants as Area

Lecture lines:
Determinants measure the area of parallelograms.
Columns of A define a base parallelogram.
Determinants represent this total signed area.

Planned animations:
Show 2D parallelogram with area=|det(A)| using #FFFFFF labels.
Highlight vectors forming the sides with colors #FF5733 and #33FF57.
Transition parallelogram to show area scaling factor.
Fade in determinant formula: |det(A)| = area.
Emphasize formula by flashing #FFFF00 on the area value.

Section: section_2 — Visualizing the Linear System

Lecture lines:
Represent Ax = b as vector combinations.
Basis vectors a1 and a2 reach b.
Find x and y scaling factors.

Planned animations:
Visualize vector b as sum of columns of A.
Color column vector a1 as #FF5733 and a2 as #33FF57.
Show scaling coefficients x1 and x2 as sliding bars.

Section: section_3 — Geometric Derivation of Cramer's Rule

Lecture lines:
Replace column a1 with target vector b.
New parallelogram formed by b and a2.
Ratio of areas gives scaling factor x.
Cramer's Rule equals area ratio calculation.
This reveals x coordinate geometrically.

Planned animations:
Display area spanned by (b, a2) as area = |det(b, a2)|.
Overlay area spanned by (a1, a2) as area = |det(a1, a2)|.
Equate ratios to solve for variable x1.
Demonstrate x1 = det(b, a2) / det(a1, a2).
Generalize result to higher dimensions with flashing #FFFF00.

Section: section_4 — Summary and Intuition

Lecture lines:
Cramer's rule is geometric area scaling.
Each factor represents an area ratio.
Intuitive way to solve linear systems.

Planned animations:
Display final Cramer's Rule formula using #FFFFFF font.
Animate transformation of area into system solution.
Flash the rule for emphasis using #FFFF00.
